integrity: An explicit analytic proof handles all real success probabilities and all positive integer approximating trial counts. An exact-rational finite verifier only corroborates algebra and examples. The review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Two independent Bernoulli source summands only. The pointwise nearest binomial distribution for each input pair is not characterized. No extension to an arbitrary number of source summands is asserted. Historical priority is not guaranteed by the available literature coverage.
title: Sharp quarter-radius binomial approximation of two heterogeneous Bernoulli trials
